title: 2024-25 Panini NBA Hoops Tristan Da Silva #16 Arriving Now Orlando Magic RC
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2024-25 Panini NBA Hoops basketball trading card featuring Tristan Da Silva of the Orlando Magic. The card is part of the Rookie insert set and is labeled as "Arriving Now." It is a short print 1st Edition card made of 20 Pt. card stock. The card is a base variation with no autograph or signature, manufactured in the United States. A collectible item for NBA fans and card enthusiasts.
